title: solandra squamea
intro: Solandra squamea, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Jessamine, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, coughs, and fever, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Solandra squamea are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve muscle spasms, and act as a sedative, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
